subject: Your EOB Is Ready to View
body: Your explanation of benefits for last month's visits is now available in your member account. This is a summary of how your claim was processed and is not a bill. Log in anytime to view the details.

subject: Claims Update
body: Hi, just wanted to let you know the claim from your visit last month has finished processing. Everything came through as expected under your plan. No action needed on your part, but feel free to reach out if you have questions.

subject: EOB Available — No Action Required
body: Your EOB is available online. No action is required.

subject: Your Claim Has Been Processed
body: This is to let you know your recent claim has finished processing and payment has been issued to your provider according to your plan's coverage terms. You can view the full breakdown in your online member portal at your convenience.

subject: Statement of Benefits - Visit on the 12th
body: Enclosed is your statement of benefits for the office visit on the 12th of this month. This document outlines the amount billed, the amount covered under your plan, and your remaining patient responsibility, if any. Please retain this for your records.

subject: hey, quick note about your claim
body: just wanted to give you a heads up that your claim went through fine, nothing you need to do. you can check the details online whenever :)

subject: Coverage Summary for Recent Visit
body: Attached is a summary of how your recent visit was covered under your plan. Your provider was paid directly and you are not responsible for any additional balance based on this claim. Coverage_Summary.pdf Let us know if anything looks off.

subject: Your Benefits Statement Has Been Mailed
body: A paper copy of your benefits statement for your recent claim has also been mailed to the address on file, in case you prefer to review it that way. The same information is available online as well.

subject: No Balance Due - Claim Finalized
body: Claim finalized. No balance due. View details in your portal if interested.

subject: Explanation of Benefits Now Posted
body: Please be advised that your explanation of benefits for the claim submitted on your behalf has now been posted to your secure member account. We recommend reviewing it at your convenience, though no immediate action is required.

subject: Your out-of-pocket cost for last visit
body: Just letting you know your out-of-pocket cost for last week's visit came to $40, consistent with your specialist copay. The rest was covered under your plan. Full details are in your online account whenever you'd like to take a look.

subject: Quarterly Claims Summary
body: As part of our regular member communications, please find attached a summary of all claims processed on your behalf over the past quarter. This document is provided for your records and does not require any action unless you notice a discrepancy, in which case our member services team is happy to assist. Quarterly_Claims_Summary.pdf

subject: Your recent ER visit — coverage details
body: Coverage details for your recent emergency room visit have been finalized and are now viewable in your account. Your plan covered the visit according to your emergency care benefit, and no further payment is expected from you for this claim.

subject: EOB posted (FYI only)
body: Your EOB for the recent claim has posted. FYI only, nothing needed from you.

subject: Update from your insurance provider
body: We wanted to update you on the status of a claim recently submitted under your policy. The claim has been reviewed and processed according to the terms of your plan, and payment has already been sent to your provider directly.

subject: Your Plan Paid This Claim in Full
body: Good news — your plan covered this claim in full, so there's nothing further owed on your end. You can see the full breakdown online if you'd like, but no action is needed.

subject: Claim Summary Attached
body: Attached is the claim summary for your visit last month. Nothing further needed from you at this time. Claim_Summary_Sept.pdf

subject: Confirming Your Recent Claim
body: We are writing to confirm that your recent claim has been reviewed and processed in accordance with your policy terms. A detailed explanation of benefits is available for your review in the member portal.

subject: You're all set — claim processed
body: You're all set, the claim from your recent visit has been processed and everything checked out fine on our end. Log in anytime if you want to see the numbers.

subject: Deductible Update
body: This claim brings you closer to meeting your annual deductible. You've now met $850 of your $1,200 deductible for this plan year. The full breakdown is available in your account whenever you'd like to review it.

subject: Provider Payment Confirmation
body: This confirms payment has been issued to your provider for the claim submitted on your behalf. No balance remains due from you for this visit.

subject: Reviewing your last statement
body: Just following up to make sure you received your last benefits statement — sometimes these end up in spam folders. If you haven't seen it yet, it's also available anytime in your online account. No action needed either way.

subject: Claim Processed Under Your Family Plan
body: This claim, submitted under your family plan, has been processed and paid according to your coverage. You can view which family member the claim applies to and the payment breakdown in your secure portal.

subject: Nothing you need to do here
body: This is just a routine notice that a claim on your account has finished processing. There's genuinely nothing you need to do — this is for your records only.

subject: Nice, your claim was approved
body: Good news, the claim from your visit last week was approved without any issues. You can check the payment details online whenever you're curious.

subject: Statement Available - Physical Therapy Visits
body: Your statement for the recent series of physical therapy visits is now available online. This reflects the combined coverage across all sessions billed this month. Please review at your convenience.

subject: Your recent lab work was covered
body: This is to confirm that recent lab work ordered by your provider was covered under your plan's preventive care benefit, meaning there's no cost to you for this particular claim.

subject: Insurance Update: Specialist Visit
body: We wanted to update you regarding the specialist visit claim submitted last month. After review, the claim was processed according to your plan's specialist benefit tier, and your provider has already received payment. You are not responsible for any further balance related to this visit.

subject: Payment Sent to Your Provider
body: Payment has been sent to your provider for your recent visit. Nothing further needed from you.

subject: Just a heads up on your claim status
body: Heads up — your claim status changed to 'paid' this morning. You can peek at the details in your portal whenever, but there's nothing urgent here.

subject: Your Plan's Coverage of Recent Imaging
body: This notice explains how your plan covered the recent imaging study ordered by your provider. Your plan applied your standard imaging benefit, and the remaining balance, if any, will appear on a separate statement from your provider's office.

subject: Member Services Follow-Up
body: Our member services team wanted to follow up on a claim you inquired about recently. That claim has since been fully processed, and we hope this resolves your question. Please reach out again if anything still looks unclear.

subject: Wellness visit — fully covered
body: Your recent wellness visit was fully covered under your plan's preventive benefits, so there's no cost to you for this claim. Thanks for staying on top of your preventive care!

subject: Explanation of Benefits — Urgent Care Visit
body: Please find below the explanation of benefits for your recent urgent care visit. Your plan's urgent care copay of $50 applied, and the remainder of the visit cost was covered by your plan.

subject: Routine account notice
body: This is a routine notice regarding activity on your account. A claim was processed this week; view details online if you'd like.

subject: Your claim, explained simply
body: We know these notices can be confusing, so here's the short version: your recent claim was processed, your provider was paid, and you don't owe anything extra for this visit. Full details are online if you want them.

subject: Copay confirmation
body: This confirms your $25 copay was applied correctly to your recent visit. No further balance is expected.

subject: Annual benefits recap
body: As the year wraps up, we wanted to send a quick recap of how your benefits were used this year. You can find a full list of processed claims, payments, and remaining deductible information in your online account. Thank you for being a member with us this year.

subject: Your specialist copay was applied
body: Your specialist copay of $35 was applied to the recent visit claim. The remaining balance was covered under your plan. No action is needed from you.

subject: Notice: Claim Reprocessed (Correction)
body: We identified a small error in how a recent claim was initially processed and have since corrected it. The corrected explanation of benefits is now available online. This correction resulted in no change to your out-of-pocket cost.

subject: Behavioral health visit — coverage note
body: This note confirms that your recent behavioral health visit was covered under your plan's mental health benefit, consistent with your medical coverage. Your provider has been paid directly and no balance is due from you.

subject: quick fyi
body: fyi your claim from last week processed fine, nothing to do on your end.

subject: Your Plan Year Deductible Has Been Met
body: Congratulations — with this claim, you've now met your deductible for the current plan year. Going forward, your plan will cover eligible expenses at a higher rate for the rest of the year. Details are available in your account.

subject: Statement Correction Notice
body: We're writing to let you know a minor correction was made to a previously issued benefits statement. The updated version is now available online and reflects the accurate payment amount. No action is required on your end.

subject: Your telehealth visit was processed
body: Your recent telehealth visit has been processed under your plan's virtual care benefit. Coverage for telehealth visits mirrors your in-person specialist benefit, and this claim required no out-of-pocket cost from you.

subject: Reminder: view your EOB anytime
body: Just a gentle reminder that your explanation of benefits for recent claims is always available to view in your member account, whenever it's convenient for you. No need to act on this reminder.

subject: Claims processed — nothing outstanding
body: All claims submitted on your account this month have been processed, and there is nothing outstanding on your end. Thank you for keeping your information up to date with us.
